article.title: abcdefghijkl​m​n​o​p​q​r​s​t in a title breaks at twelve
article.subtitle: abcdefghijkl​m​n​o​p​q​r​s​t in a subtitle also breaks at twelve
article.content:
abcdefghijkl in a heading is exactly the heading threshold
abcdefghijkl​m in a heading is one over
abcdefghijkl​m​n​o​p​q​r​s​t in a heading breaks early
abcdefghijkl​m​n​o​p​q​r​s​t breaks in an h6 too
a heading with abcdefghijkl​m​n​o​p​q​r​s​t nested inside a tag
abcdefgabcde​f​g​h is fifteen across an em tag, which is over twelve
a heading holding abcdefghijklmnopqrst as link text abcdefghijkl​m​n​o​p​q​r​s​t in a caption breaks at twelve too abcdefghijklmnopqrst is only twenty, so the same word is left alone in body text
abcdefghijkl. in a heading is thirteen only because of its period abcdefghijklmnopqrst as an author is set at body size, so it is left alone
